description: Sales promises quantity, contract uses different unit

source_documents.sales_conversation: Customer: 'How many API calls do we get?' Sales: 'You get one million API calls per month.'
source_documents.contract_text: Section 4.1 Service Quota: The Service includes 12,000,000 API invocations per annual subscription term.

promises.evidence: You get one million API calls per month.

contract_terms.evidence: The Service includes 12,000,000 API invocations per annual subscription term.

alignments.reasoning: 1M/month × 12 months = 12M/year. Numerically equivalent, different unit of time.
